scripts.use:public: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install mnemonica@latest @mnemonica/dive@latest @mnemonica/tactica@latest @mnemonica/topologica@latest @mnemonica/nestjs@latest --save && echo 'Switched to PUBLIC npm dependencies (latest)'
scripts.use:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.dependencies.mnemonica='file:../core';p.dependencies['@mnemonica/dive']='file:../dive';p.dependencies['@mnemonica/tactica']='file:../tactica';p.dependencies['@mnemonica/topologica']='file:../topologica';fs.mkdirSync('.local-links',{recursive:true});const nv=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../nestjs-adapter/package.json','utf8')).version;require('child_process').execSync('npm pack ../nestjs-adapter --pack-destination .local-links',{stdio:'inherit'});p.dependencies['@mnemonica/nestjs']='file:.local-links/mnemonica-nestjs-'+nv+'.tgz';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,'\t')+'\n');console.log('Switched to LOCAL file: dependencies (mnemonica family incl. @mnemonica/nestjs)')"
